scope: React/Vite 现代单页应用模板在静态构建及纯前端本地运行环境下的官方能力验证
content: You are using the default build output location (dist)... package.json: {"scripts": {"build": "vite build", "preview": "vite preview"}}... vite preview is intended for previewing the build locally... instructions for performing a static deployment
conclusion: Vite 官方文档证实支持通过 vite build 输出纯静态资产（dist 目录），并通过 vite preview 或任何静态 Web 服务器在本地离线或零后端环境下运行。
